parameters.name: DataLinkName
parameters.description:
The datalink name for cross-instance queries.

> - This parameter is required if `UseDsql` is set to `1`.
>
> - The datalink name can contain only lowercase letters and underscores (\_).
>
> - The datalink name must be unique within the tenant.

parameters.name: DatabasePassword
parameters.description: The password for the database account.

parameters.name: DatabaseUser
parameters.description: The username for the database account.

parameters.name: DbaUid
parameters.description: The UID of the user with the Database Administrator (DBA) role for the instance. You can call the [ListUsers](~~141938~~) or [GetInstance](~~141567~~) operation to get this ID.

parameters.name: DbaUidByString
parameters.description: This parameter replaces `DbaUid` and supports non-numeric UIDs, such as the UIDs of RAM roles.

parameters.name: DdlOnline
parameters.description:
The strategy for lock-free schema changes. Valid values:

- **0**: Disabled.

- **1**: Prioritize native lock-free operations. If an operation fails, it falls back to Data Management (DMS) for execution.

- **2**: Use Data Management (DMS) for lock-free schema changes.

> Supported database types: ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL, PolarDB for MySQL, ApsaraDB for MyBase (MySQL), and other MySQL-compatible databases.

parameters.name: EcsInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the ECS instance.

> This parameter is required if `InstanceSource` is set to `ECS_OWN`.

parameters.name: EcsRegion
parameters.description:
The region where the instance is located.

> This parameter is required if `InstanceSource` is set to `RDS`, `ECS_OWN`, or `VPC_IDC`.

parameters.name: EnableSellSitd
parameters.description:
- **Y**: Enable sensitive data protection.

- **NULL or other values**: Disable sensitive data protection.

parameters.name: EnvType
parameters.description:
The environment type. Valid values:

- `product`: production environment

- `dev`: development environment

- `pre`: pre-release environment

- `test`: test environment

- `sit`: system integration testing (SIT) environment

- `uat`: user acceptance testing (UAT) environment

- `pet`: performance testing environment

- `stag`: staging environment

parameters.name: ExportTimeout
parameters.description: The export timeout period, in seconds.

parameters.name: Host
parameters.description: The endpoint of the database instance.

parameters.name: InstanceAlias
parameters.description: An alias for the instance to help you identify it quickly.

parameters.name: InstanceSource
parameters.description:
The source of the database instance. Valid values:

- **PUBLIC\_OWN**: a self-managed instance connected over the Internet.

- **RDS**: an ApsaraDB RDS instance.

- **ECS\_OWN**: a self-managed instance that is deployed on an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.

- **VPC\_IDC**: a self-managed instance in a data center that is connected to a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC).

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description: The database type. For more information, see [DbType parameter description](~~198106~~).

parameters.name: NetworkType
parameters.description:
The network type. Valid values:

- **CLASSIC**: classic network

- **VPC**: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The connection port of the database instance.

parameters.name: QueryTimeout
parameters.description: The query timeout period, in seconds.

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: SafeRule
parameters.description: The name of the Security Rule Set (GroupName) for the instance. You can call the [ListStandardGroups](~~417891~~) or [GetInstance](~~141567~~) operation to get this value.

parameters.name: Sid
parameters.description:
The system ID (SID) of the database.

> This parameter is required if `InstanceType` is set to `ORACLE`.

parameters.name: SkipTest
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to skip the connectivity test. Valid values:

- **true**: Skip the test.

- **false**: Perform the test.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the sensitivity classification template. You can call the [ListClassificationTemplates](~~460613~~) operation to get this ID.

parameters.name: TemplateType
parameters.description: The type of the sensitivity classification template. You can call the [ListClassificationTemplates](~~460613~~) operation to get this value.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description: The tenant ID. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) operation to get this ID.

parameters.name: UseDsql
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable cross-instance queries. Valid values:

- **0**: Disabled

- **1**: Enabled

> Supported database types: MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Oracle-compatible), and Redis.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description:
The ID of the VPC.

> This parameter is required if `InstanceSource` is set to `VPC_IDC`.
